Body.Content:
During public preview in early-release environments, the updated SharePoint/Microsoft Lists app-from-data experience gives makers responsive record browsing with grid and list views, plus separate screens for creating and editing records. It creates a standalone canvas app, not an embedded SharePoint customized form. Connector and formula delegation limits still apply.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/app-from-sharepoint

GA date: February CY2027

Preview date: November CY2026
